note: Standalone probe run before building gate 3's full renderer, to decide between the service-worker createServer path and the more complex protocol.handle custom-scheme fallback.
conclusion: Electron treats a file:// origin loaded via loadFile() as a secure context, so service worker registration succeeds without any extra scheme registration. The custom-scheme fallback in main.cjs (orivon-media, registered via protocol.registerSchemesAsPrivileged before app.whenReady) is left in place but unused by this gate.
